{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.10

|gr1= Environment

|descr= Sets the provided Thermal Imaging parameter's value.
{{Feature|important|The settings are '''not''' saved in savegame and must be reapplied after loading.}}

|s1= [[setTIParameter]] [paramName, newValue]

|p1= paramName: [[String]] - the parameter name. See [[getTIParameters]] for a list of possible values

|p2= newValue: [[Number]]<!-- technically anything --> - the set number

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>
setTIParameter ["OutputRangeStart", 0];
setTIParameter ["OutputRangeWidth", 1];
</sqf>

|seealso= [[getTIParameters]] [[setCamUseTI]] [[disableTIEquipment]]
}}
